2115403410744963212.en_summary: @StockSavvyShay says $IREN just secured $363M in financing backed by GPUs that already generate revenue under multi-year customer contracts. Given concerns around AI lending, IREN can now borrow against existing infrastructure to fund its next buildout without issuing more shares. An image is attached.
2115403410744963212.zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay 表示 $IREN 剛取得 3.63 億美元融資，以已在多年期客戶合約下產生收入的 GPU 作擔保。在市場擔憂 AI 借貸之際，IREN 可以用現有基礎設施借款，為下一階段擴建融資，而無需增發股份。附上圖片。

2115404218580541486.en_summary: @Stephanie_Link says $VRT posted EPS up 78% and revenue up 61% with solid margins and free cash flow up 67%, guiding organic growth up 50% for Q4 and 38% for the full year, quoting management: "We are in the middle of the largest infrastructure buildout and it's accelerating."
2115404218580541486.zh_summary: @Stephanie_Link 表示 $VRT 每股盈利增長 78%，營收增長 61%，利潤率穩健，自由現金流增長 67%；公司預期第四季有機增長 50%，全年增長 38%，並引述管理層稱「我們正處於規模最大的基礎設施建設之中，而且正在加速」。

2115406398628770120.en_summary: @OptionsHawk says S&P futures $ES_F are set for a positive open after a strong weekly candle off the 38.2% retracement support at 7680, starting to clear the trend of lower highs. Overhead are the 1-month VPOC and a major point of control near 7770, AVWAP resistance from the October highs at 7773 and 7800, the 61.8% Fibonacci level, needed to work back to record highs. Bulls should defend the 1-week VWAP and point of control at 7727 and the AVWAP off the lows at 7712.5. A chart is attached.
2115406398628770120.zh_summary: @OptionsHawk 表示標普期貨 $ES_F 預計高開，此前在 7680 的 38.2% 回撤支撐位收出強勁週線，並開始擺脫高點逐步下移的走勢。上方阻力包括約 7770 的一個月成交量控制點與主要控制點、10 月高點起算的 AVWAP 阻力 7773，以及作為 61.8% 斐波那契位的 7800，須突破才能重返紀錄高位。多方需守住 7727 的一週 VWAP 與控制點，以及低點起算的 AVWAP 7712.5。附上圖表。
